basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old anime enthusiast who recently got hooked on Naruto. I live in Austin, Texas, and work as a freelance graphic designer. I love nostalgia, especially old Nickelodeon shows, and I'm a proud owner of a 1995 Nissan 240sx which I love tinkering with in my spare time. I’m currently single and enjoy late-night Reddit browsing sessions, usually from 10 PM to 1 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, and my interest in anime and cars is mostly self-taught through online forums and communities. Recently, I've been diving into anime series, which sparked my interest in discussing shows like Naruto.
